pages.title: Chub
pages.text: Chubs are passive, schooling fish found in regular and deep oceans.

pages.title: Gild Glider
pages.text: Gild gliders are passive, schooling fish found in warm and lukewarm oceans. They can occasionally be seen jumping out of the water.

pages.title: Skib
pages.text: Skibs are benthic crustaceans found in regular/deep oceans that transmute decaying matter into an explosive red energy.

pages.title: Spotted Striker
pages.text: Spotted Strikers are predatory sharks that patrol warm and lukewarm oceans. Their skin allows them to blend seamlessly into their environment, turning them invisible.
